_note: SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL asset context for the alert-triage lab. No real entities, PII, secrets, or production identifiers.

AST-IDP-01.name: Helios Identity Tenant
AST-IDP-01.notes: Controls sign-in, MFA, and OAuth consent for all Meridian Union users. Privileged identity impact requires escalation.

AST-PAY-API-01.name: Orchid Payment API
AST-PAY-API-01.notes: Handles tokenized payment events. Public ACL changes or exfiltration indicators are Critical.

AST-FS-02.name: Iris Claims File Share
AST-FS-02.notes: Hosts claims documents. Ransomware canary alerts require immediate isolation and escalation.

AST-FIN-LAP-07.name: Finance Approver Workstation
AST-FIN-LAP-07.notes: Used by fictional payment approver account. Credential or OAuth abuse should escalate.

AST-ENG-BLD-04.name: Cobalt Build Runner 04
AST-ENG-BLD-04.notes: Ephemeral build runner. Suspicious commands are important but usually not destructive unless secrets or lateral movement are observed.

AST-HR-SaaS-01.name: Luma HR Portal
AST-HR-SaaS-01.notes: Contains synthetic employee records. Bulk export to an unapproved destination is High and may escalate.

AST-CLOUD-STG-09.name: Nimbus Analytics Bucket
AST-CLOUD-STG-09.notes: Large object downloads plus public ACL changes indicate potential exfiltration and require escalation.

AST-VPN-EDGE-01.name: Northgate VPN Edge
AST-VPN-EDGE-01.notes: Successful anomalous admin login or exploit attempt may require escalation; blocked scanner probes are low.

AST-SCAN-01.name: Quill Approved Scanner
AST-SCAN-01.notes: Approved vulnerability scanner using the redcanary-scan user-agent during weekly windows.

AST-DEV-SBX-03.name: Umber Malware Test Sandbox
AST-DEV-SBX-03.notes: Expected to run test malware strings. Blocked activity is normally benign or low unless it reaches production.

AST-DB-INV-01.name: Inventory Ledger Database
AST-DB-INV-01.notes: Nightly ETL to the approved warehouse is expected between 02:00 and 03:00 UTC.

AST-EXEC-LAP-02.name: Executive Laptop 02
AST-EXEC-LAP-02.notes: Endpoint for fictional executive role. Credential access or persistence is High.

AST-FIN-APP-01.name: Aurora Finance Approvals App
AST-FIN-APP-01.notes: Holds synthetic payment-approval records. Bulk export to an unapproved destination is High and may escalate; combined with identity compromise it is part of a Critical campaign.
